_benched_revisit_later.flavor: If she dyes it, the scene wears it.

moves.name: Dye Anyone
moves.desc: Choose 1 Voice in play. Change their type to THE COLOR for the rest of the match.

moves.name: On-Camera
moves.desc: Draw cards until you have 6. Your next attack does +40.

_benched_revisit_later.lore:
Alt-hair colorist working out of a chair in San Antonio. Dyes the scene one head at a time — pastel pink, electric blue, leopard streaks, whatever the client brings in.

The on-camera face of the brand. If a Take post has a person in the frame, it usually started in her chair. She picks the colors, books the chair, and walks every subject through the cut while VampPsych rolls cameras.

The color authority. Final word on what the scene actually wears.

_benched_revisit_later.name: VampPsych & Cam
_benched_revisit_later.flavor: The whole picture, with a face on it.

moves.name: Behind & In Front
moves.desc: Hits two Voices for 100 each, or one for 200.

moves.name: Pretty First With Teeth GX
moves.desc: You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a match.

_benched_revisit_later.lore:
Two curators, one outlet. VampPsych behind the lens, Cam in front of it. The brand reads exactly because both seats are filled.

The pretty-first comes from her. The teeth come from him. Every drop on 0FF THE PRINT carries both signatures.

TAG TEAM rule: when this card is in play, both curators are on the record.
